jobs.name: score-bag-icon
jobs.prompt: Polished hand-painted 2D game UI asset for an elegant musical theater fantasy game. Antique ivory paper, restrained warm brass-gold, deep midnight navy ink, clean readable silhouettes, subtle music engraving, consistent with an ornate blue and gold concert theater HUD. No science fiction, no neon, no holograms, no text, no letters, no watermark. A SINGLE standalone HUD inventory icon: a small open sheet music folio, two lightly curved cream pages with visible short dark musical staves and a few elegant notes, a tiny dark-blue binding. Front-facing with minimal depth, readable at 80 pixels. The PAPER SILHOUETTE ITSELF is the icon. Absolutely NO enclosing circle, NO border, NO badge, NO ring, NO frame, NO pedestal, NO backing plate. Centered, entire folio fits with 14 percent empty padding. Pure solid BLACK surrounding background for later extraction, no cast shadow outside the paper, no glow.
